title: A Map at the Mat
lines: A map! Tap the map, Sam.
Sam and Pam pat the map.

questions.listenFor: A map. The second line begins with it, and the exclamation mark is a clue.
Pam. If they say Sam, have them look again at the line with Pam in it.

questions.ask: Where do you think the map goes? Tell me.
questions.listenFor: Anything they like. You are listening for an idea of their own.
